senses.gloss:
The semi-vowel व् is substituted for the उ of हु and for that of नु (the characteristic of स्वादिगणः (5th Conjugation), before a सार्वधातुक affix -- तिङ्शित्सार्वधातुकम् ३.४.११३, beginning with a vowel when the अङ्ग (stem) consists of more than one syllable and the उ is not preceded by a conjunct consonant.

Terms: Semi-vowel substitution
